title: Cities Skylines | Franklin, Episode 2: New Norway
premise: The presenter builds fictional New Norway forts Sven, Jens and Hans while arguing that mercantilist extraction and subsistence-wage logic enriched colonial powers and survive in modern essential-worker precarity. The historical and political claims are his.
coverage: Three fictional forts, farms and trading posts accompany the mercantilism explanation, followed by a modern-worker montage and a tour of the finished settlements. Historical and political claims are the presenter’s account.

panels.heading: NAFTA / anachronistic debate payoff
panels.description: Hillary Clinton in a red jacket at a debate microphone, with Global News watermark, replaces gameplay.
panels.camera: Static image inserted over gameplay.
panels.action: Static insert.
panels.visualGag: Payoff to the zero-sum setup: Donald Trump’s NAFTA-is-the-worst-trade-deal line from the September 26, 2016 presidential debate interrupts the colonial-economic lecture while the image shows his opponent Hillary Clinton. The joke connects contemporary zero-sum trade rhetoric to mercantilism and pairs the attack with the opponent’s reaction image.
panels.notes: The NAFTA line comes from Donald Trump’s September 26, 2016 debate attack, also reported by PolitiFact on September 29. Whether the audio is Trump himself or the narrator’s impression is uncertain.
